name: doc-review
description: Review design specs and implementation plans in a pane: move by block, pin comments, ask side questions, submit one review.

globs.title: Document globs
globs.description: Comma-separated globs (relative to the working directory) of documents that count as specs or plans.

offer.title: When a spec is ready
offer.description: auto: open the review pane when the model asks for a review; toast: only show a toast and status line; off: never offer, /doc-review only.

explainModel.title: Explain model
explainModel.description: The model alias or id that answers 'explain this passage' (h). A small fast model keeps it cheap.

approvePhrase.title: Approval phrase
approvePhrase.description: What the approve action sends to the model as your words.
